articles.content: Nvidia Corp. CEO Jensen Huang stepped down after revelations of an extramarital relationship with a company vice president, which violated the company's code of conduct. The company's board had rarely considered a future without Huang, who had structured the company around himself with no chairman, no No. 2, and no public succession plan. Huang's successor will have to figure out how to run a company built around someone who is no longer there, a challenge that is a "real failure of leadership" by Huang. Beth Kowitt, Bloomberg Opinion Columnist, joins to discuss her recent column on the "key-man" CEO issue. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.content: 八年研究，两个落地系统，超六万GitHub Stars。    作者丨李秋悦    编辑丨吴   彤                                                                                                       一支女团跳舞，镜头不必再听导演安排，观众甚至能看到拍摄时不存在的机位。传统MV拍摄，摄影机架在哪里，观众看到的就是哪个角度。现在用多台摄像机同时记录舞者动作，再重建出一个三维动态场景，镜头可以任意调换位置；从队形正面绕到侧面，穿过舞者之间，甚至换一个从未真正架设过的机位，重新观看刚才的表演。今年10月，韩国SM娱乐创始人李秀满在新女团A2O LITE的出道活动上，展示了这项名为4D Gaussian Splatting（4DGS）的技术。SM娱乐旗下女团A2O LITE 《NEON》运用4DV.ai的4DGS新技术彭思达对这项技术很熟悉。六年前，彭思达师从浙大教授周晓巍读博，在浙大CAD&CG国家重点实验室的三维视觉研究团队ZJU3DV下研究的就是动态三维人体重建。很快他做的Neural Body入选CVPR 2021最佳论文候选，4K4D把动态场景的渲染推进到4K实时水平，FreeTimeGS把渲染质量推进到可落地的程度。实验室积累的技术后来被一家名为4DV.ai的创业公司采用，出现了在影视飓风的视频里。技术走出了实验室，但彭思达没有继续留在这个赛道。2023年博士毕业后，彭思达选择留校任教，入选浙江大学软件学院“百人计划”研究员，把研究对象从人体换成了街道。理想汽车找上门来，双方合作自动驾驶仿真系统，Street Gaussians被应用到了理想汽车的仿真系统中。两年后，自动驾驶仿真技术逐渐收敛，彭思达又开始研究机器人导航。从动态三维人体重建、自动驾驶仿真到具身智能，作为一个做了多年计算机视觉的研究者，彭思达反而认为视觉并不是智能的主角。对于像人一样思考、推理和规划，文本可能更重要；对于机器人学会操作，重要的是真正理解动作轨迹的因果性。“到了具身领域，视觉模态仍然不是主角，动作模态才是主角。”以下是AI科技评论与浙江大学软件学院“百人计划”研究员彭思达的对话，在不改变原意的基础上有所编辑。01端到端不是最优解▎AI科技评论：你们最近10月份公开的SuperNav和ScaleNav两项工作，分别对应机器人导航的「大脑」和「小脑」。为什么你们要把导航拆成「大脑」和「小脑」？彭思达：我们观察到一个现象。之前很多人希望训练一个端到端导航模型，也就是微调一个VLM，让它直接预测行动。但我们持续尝试以后发现，这样微调有两个问题。第一，把VLM的能力变差了。VLM本来还可以做一些识别等任务，一旦要求它直接输出动作，它就变笨了。第二，他们使用的VLM本身就不是那么聪明。我们试过一些3B或者4B模型，给它一张图片，问一些问题，发现它的空间推理能力很差。但为什么要用这些模型？因为只有3B或者4B这种模型，才能微调得动，所以这就有点不那么本质。▎AI科技评论：你认为VLM直接预测动作不够本质，甚至可能损害原有能力。那问题出在哪里？彭思达：我个人的看法是大部分公司不具备训练出通用智能模型的能力，只有OpenAI这种基模公司才真正掌握了训练VLM的能力。要给模型注入某种能力，一定不是微调，一定得在预训练过程中就有这样的过程。如果某个小团队以前从来没训练过这种模型，突然号称微调一下就获得了这种能力，我认为大概率是在某个小数据集上过拟合，实际上没有任何能力上的验证，也没有技术进步性。▎AI科技评论： 你们最终选择了什么方案？彭思达：我们认为导航最重要的是回归问题本身，怎么更好地做决策、交互，怎么在环境里面更好地移动。刚好Agentic System、Coding Agent这种架构出现以后，我们发现非常适合满足这个技术需求。既然走Coding Agent路线，就以通用多模态大模型作为核心，让它负责整体规划、决策、推理。具体怎么在环境中执行，只需要给Coding Agent提供合适的工具

articles.title: NearLink E1.0 也有新特性！华为 MatePad Pro 13.2 2023 等平板获推支持星闪电竞专链功能
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，在 6 月初的华为 nova 16 系列及全场景新品发布会上，华为终端 BG CEO 何刚带来了一款路由新品 —— 华为凌霄子母路由 Q7 电线版。其搭载星闪技术，提供星闪电竞专链功能，支持华为手机 / 平板直连，对比传统 WiFi，可降低游戏网络卡顿率。IT之家注意到，华为 MatePad Pro 13.2 2023 等机型推送了鸿蒙 HarmonyOS 7.0.0.111 SP16 版本升级，带来了星闪电竞专链功能 —— 支持与具备星闪电竞专链特性的华为路由，基于星闪连接技术建立专属连接，提升游戏运行的流畅度与稳定性。作为参考，华为官网显示，MatePad Pro 13.2 2023 支持的星闪版本为 NearLink E1.0，这意味着更多初代星闪设备也将支持这项新特性。需要注意的是，星闪连接和 WiFi 连接绑定（即和连接对应 WiFi 的路由才可建立星闪连接），未连接 WiFi 时，星闪手机无法连接星闪路由器。延伸阅读星闪（NearLink）是中国自主创新的新一代无线短距通信技术，聚焦于重塑流畅、稳定的设备连接体验，具备低时延、高并发、高可靠、抗干扰等特性。其主导机构为国际星闪联盟（全称国际星闪联盟无线短距通信联盟），该联盟于 2020 年 9 月成立，由行业机构、高校和科研院所、芯片、整车、手机终端、家电等各领域单位组成，并于 2023 年 5 月取得民政部颁发的社会团体法人登记证书，正式成为国际性产业与标准组织。关于文章提到的星闪版本，据华为官网说明，星闪 E1.0（NearLink E1.0）主打“可发现、可连接”，保证设备之间“互连互通”，典型应用包括星闪鼠标、星闪手写笔、星闪游戏手柄、星闪水杯等；而星闪 E2.0（NearLink E2.0）则对应“星闪音频”，是在 E1.0（星闪连接）的基础上，新增了专门为提升音质和音频体验设计的优化方案、协议及编解码，让音频传输更高效、更清晰，例如 FreeBuds 系列、FreeClip 2 等耳机产品。华为凌霄子母路由 Q7 电线版于 2026 年 6 月 1 日在成都举行的华为 nova 16 系列及全场景新品发布会上发布。根据华为官网规格参数，该路由支持第三代凌霄 PLC 组网、Wi-Fi 7+、双频无缝漫游、灵犀双 Wi-Fi、星闪电竞专链以及星闪蓝牙双模网关等功能，母路由理论无线速率总和为 3570 Mbps。至于此次获推新功能的华为 MatePad Pro 13.2 英寸，其于 2023 年 9 月 25 日发布，官方发行价 5199 元起，是华为第一款官宣星闪技术的产品。该平板搭载 13.2 英寸柔性 OLED 屏幕，分辨率为 2880×1920 像素，出厂搭载 HarmonyOS 4 系统，电池等效容量为 10100 mAh（典型值）。

articles.content: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，OpenAI 今天（13 日）宣布推出支付功能 ChatGPT Wallet，让旗下 dot AI 智能体代替用户购物。ChatGPT Wallet 由 OpenAI 与美国运通、万事达卡和 Visa 合作开发，用户使用现有信用卡付款时，仍可享受原有的积分奖励和权益保障。符合条件的用户只需录入一次银行卡信息，随后便可让 dot 智能体帮忙寻找商品，每笔交易都需要通过安全验证才能完成。OpenAI 强调，dot 智能体不会接触用户的真实银行卡信息。支付网络会为每笔交易生成专用的支付令牌，其中包含限定用途的卡号、安全码和有效期，供智能体完成付款。当今，越来越多消费者开始尝试用个人 AI 智能体管理日程、预订旅行和处理其他日常事务，ChatGPT Wallet 在这样的背景下应运而生。ChatGPT Wallet 未来有望成为 OpenAI 新的收入来源。初期不会向交易收取佣金，OpenAI 当前的目标是更希望与商家建立合作关系，让消费者逐渐将 ChatGPT 视为购物平台，尤其是在商家也开始探索个人 AI 智能体的用途之际。ChatGPT Wallet 初期仅向美国年满 18 岁的 OpenAI Pro 订阅用户开放。据IT之家了解，截至今年第三季度末，ChatGPT 每周活跃用户超过 12 亿，付费用户接近 1 亿。OpenAI 指出，利用 AI 智能体购物仍处于起步阶段。公司在发布 ChatGPT Wallet 的同时，还推出了面向企业的工具和指南，帮助商家适应这种变化，其中就包括如何检查网站是否误拦截了 OpenAI 的智能体。

articles.title: Ask HN: Has AI coding changed who builds your internal tools?
articles.content:
In a large company, a dedicated team might build an internal tool that dozens of other teams use. If your team needs a feature for its own workflow, you have to explain the use case, agree on how it fits into the shared tool, and wait for it to get prioritised.
With AI coding tools, it might now be faster for the team that needs the feature to build and maintain its own tool or completely scratch the tool and rebuild it if need. I’m curious how that plays out once the tool has been in use for a while.
So is paradigm shifting where we remove centralisation of building internal tools and let teams decide?

articles.title: 大规模故障殃及全球多地多行业，微软确认主要软件服务恢复工作已取得进展
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，据彭博社今天（13 日）深夜报道，微软旗下主要软件服务的恢复工作取得进展。这场大规模故障导致全球多地政府机构、金融交易员和企业业务陷入瘫痪。微软在纽约时间 13 日上午 9 时许（IT之家注：对应北京时间 22 时）发布的通报确认，服务运行情况有所改善，积压邮件数量大幅减少，接近正常水平。但 20 多款产品和服务仍可能出现错误。时间来到当地时间今天上午，用户连续第二天遭遇会议邀请无法送达、网页无响应等问题。微软以往的服务故障很少持续数小时以上。自当地时间 12 日下午故障发生以来，微软几乎每小时都会公布修复进展，包括排查系统故障、将用户流量转移至其他服务器等措施。虽然期间几次出现恢复迹象，但服务状况很快再次恶化。故障原因尚未查明。微软称，部分服务器的一个核心进程因负载过高而彻底停止响应，最初的故障排查和修复工作也因服务器继续报错而受阻。待故障结束后，微软将公布更多细节，没有证据表明此次事件涉及恶意活动。微软故障还迫使部分企业推迟财报发布，瑞士奢侈品集团历峰、以及美国卡车和巴士制造商 Workhorse Group 成为此轮受害者。拥有 Calvin Klein 和 Tommy Hilfiger 等品牌的服装集团 PVH 宣布了重组计划，将裁减约 4% 的全球员工。一名不具名的知情人士称，公司原定当地时间 13 日上午在亚洲与部分员工展开“艰难谈话”，但微软故障导致这些谈话未能如期举行，员工也因此不清楚自己能否继续留任。故障监测网站 Downdetector 收到数十万条故障报告，涉及 70 多个国家的微软用户。除邮件和聊天服务外，网络安全软件、文件共享服务及系统管理工具也受到影响。在英国，知情人士透露，微软故障影响了医疗机构的通信，英国国家医疗服务体系只能推迟部分诊疗项目。伦敦盖伊和圣托马斯医院提醒患者，电子邮件暂时无法使用，诊疗工作仍按计划进行。多个地方警察部门也表示，无法通过网络接收犯罪报案。新加坡交易员、印度证券经纪公司和东京政府官员也遇到了微软服务故障。泛欧交易所则发布通知，告知用户电子邮件通信服务中断。日本财务省称，当天大部分时间无法接收电子邮件。由于邮件系统瘫痪，日本政府各部门只能改用张贴纸质通知的方式，向记者公布每日工作安排。澳大利亚储备银行也受到波及，多个部门无法使用 Outlook，但关键业务正常运行。新西兰移民部门则暂停了所有签证申请的处理工作。

articles.title: 联合国开发计划署：现在就该采取行动应对厄尔尼诺，否则成本会翻倍
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，当地时间 13 日，联合国气候大会期间，联合国开发计划署署长亚历山大 · 德克罗接受法新社采访时指出，立即采取行动应对厄尔尼诺现象造成的严重影响，所需费用仅为推迟行动的一半。如何筹措资金应对厄尔尼诺现象带来的挑战，是本届大会争论最激烈的议题之一。德克罗说：“如果现在采取行动，应对厄尔尼诺现象需要 360 亿美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 2,406.63 亿元人民币）。如果什么都不做，代价就会达到 730 亿美元（现汇率约合 4,880.1 亿元人民币），差不多翻一番。所以问题就在于，我们是要未雨绸缪、帮助民众，还是等到后果出现再来承担？”厄尔尼诺现象每隔 2 至 7 年发生一次，通常从春季开始导致太平洋部分海域水温升高，并在随后几个月显著改变全球各地的风向、气压和降雨情况。德克罗警告：“不采取行动，就是代价最高昂的气候政策。”他呼吁各国代表团及国际货币基金组织等主要机构加大资金支持，帮助最容易受到厄尔尼诺现象冲击的发展中国家减轻灾害影响。这类投资既能挽救生命、保护农作物和基础设施，长远来看还能节省开支。联合国开发计划署本周发布的报告援引非洲开发银行的测算，揭示了本轮厄尔尼诺现象可能造成的经济影响。数据显示，非洲国家可能蒙受 100 亿至 200 亿美元（现汇率约合 668.51 亿至 1,337.01 亿元人民币）的损失。联合国拉丁美洲和加勒比经济委员会则估计，厄尔尼诺现象可能导致该地区三年内累计 GDP 损失至少达到 2%。不仅如此，经济损失将使另外 480 万人陷入贫困。德克罗强调，现在采取行动仍不算晚：“我们还来得及。我们必须大幅增加气候适应投资。无论需要花多少钱，什么都不做的代价都要高得多，远远高得多。”相关阅读：《美国宇航局示警：2026 年厄尔尼诺发展迅速，恐超过 1997 年历史最强记录》

articles.title: 捷豹路虎确认：纯电版“小卫士”新车明年见
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，据英媒 Autocar 今天（13 日）晚间报道，捷豹路虎首席执行官 PB· 巴拉吉确认，定位低于现款卫士的全新入门级 SUV 将于 2027 年投产，率先推出纯电版本。外界普遍将新车称为“卫士 Sport”，此次也是捷豹路虎首次正式公布其投产时间。全新“小卫士”将与揽胜 GT 共用 EMA 平台，提供纯电和混动两种动力选择。巴拉吉透露，混动版本的研发工作正全面推进，但只有纯电版计划在 2027 年底前具备上市条件。为给揽胜 GT 明年初投产腾出产能，发现运动版将在未来几周内停产。巴拉吉还确认，揽胜极光将在明年晚些时候逐步退出生产线，由全新小卫士接替。报道称，在捷豹路虎尚未公布名称前，新车被广泛称为“卫士 Sport”，原因在于路虎历来习惯使用 Sport 后缀区分尺寸较小的车型。另一个候选名称是“卫士 80”，以体现新车低于卫士 90、110 和 130 的定位。▲ 卫士 90据IT之家了解，捷豹路虎当前推行“品牌之家”战略，将卫士从路虎旗下的车型系列升级为独立品牌，与揽胜、发现并列。小卫士不仅是品牌独立后的首款全新车型，也是扩充卫士产品阵容的第一步。卡梅伦希望将卫士打造为“豪华生活方式品牌”，还透露了未来的产品规划：“我们现在只有一款车型，提供多个不同版本，但我正在规划未来 7 到 10 年的整个品牌产品阵容。我们必须确保卫士的所有产品都保留品牌 DNA，拥有坚固耐用、能够征服各种路况的强大性能。”卫士 Sport 并非现款卫士 90 的纯电替代车型，而是一款从头开发的新产品。为此，捷豹路虎采用专门开发、优先满足纯电车型需求的平台，需要重新考虑整车设计。新车车长预计略超过 4.5m，采用捷豹路虎 EMA 平台。定位更高端的揽胜和卫士车型则使用 MLA 平台，捷豹也拥有自主开发的 JEA 纯电平台。卡梅伦指出，将电池布置在车身底部会限制整车设计，新车的尺寸和平台布局，很可能使悬架行程和车轮交叉轴活动能力不及现款卫士。因此，小卫士的越野能力无法完全达到现款卫士的水平，不过“依旧出色”。

articles.title: 黄仁勋辞任英伟达 CEO，或给 Anthropic 下周“史上最大 IPO”添变数
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，当地时间 12 日，据《财富》杂志报道，AI 初创企业 Anthropic 即将迎来史上最受瞩目的 IPO 之一。然而，就在上市前夕，英伟达联合创始人兼 CEO 黄仁勋突然辞职。等到 Anthropic 正式登陆资本市场时，距离 AI 行业失去最有影响力、最擅长推销行业前景的人物之一，仅过去一周。黄仁勋突然离职，给 Anthropic 的上市计划增添了新的压力。此次 IPO 原本就被视为检验投资者对 AI 投资热情的重要考验。Anthropic 预计于 11 月 18 或 19 日上市，届时英伟达刚公布黄仁勋卸任 CEO 后的首份季度财报。英伟达不仅是 Anthropic 的重要合作伙伴，也深度参与此次 IPO。Anthropic 提交的文件显示，英伟达同意在与 IPO 同步进行的 260 亿美元私募配售中认购约 100 亿美元股份。两家公司还有密切的业务联系，Anthropic 承诺斥资数百亿美元，确保能够使用英伟达最先进的芯片。多名投资者和分析师指出，虽然英伟达的人事变动预计不会影响 Anthropic 的核心业务，但可能动摇市场对整个 AI 行业的信心。Seaport Research Partners 分析师杰伊 · 戈德堡，华尔街少数给予英伟达股票卖出评级的人士之一。他认为，黄仁勋离职不会影响 Anthropic 上市：“他们上市时正好赶上英伟达公布财报，我不认为这会打乱上市计划。这次 IPO 规模实在太大，参与的人又太多，他们不会撤回。”戈德堡更担心 Anthropic 上市后的处境。在黄仁勋正式辞职前，外界就传出他可能离职的消息。戈德堡当时警告，英伟达发生动荡，尤其是失去 CEO，将给 Anthropic 发布上市后的首份季度财报带来压力。“至少，市场会开始质疑：‘AI 热潮还能持续吗？还能照这样发展下去吗？’Anthropic 将面临更加尖锐的质询。”风险投资公司 M13 合伙人卡尔 · 阿洛马同样认为，Anthropic 的基本面没有改变：“在我看来，Anthropic 的处境和消息传出前一样好，实力也一样强。Anthropic 的财务数据非常出色，而且显然拥有超出自身需求的算力储备。他们并没有花那么多钱。”与部分竞争对手相比，Anthropic 对英伟达的依赖也较小。除了英伟达的硬件，Anthropic 还使用谷歌 TPU、亚马逊 Trainium 芯片和 AMD GPU 运行部分 AI 模型。据报道，Anthropic 还在考虑自行研发芯片。曾在沃顿商学院任教的会计师兼调查记者弗朗辛 · 麦肯纳认为，英伟达对 Anthropic 的投资承诺很可能不受影响：“英伟达承诺在 Anthropic 上市时投资 100 亿美元。等到 IPO 真正启动，这笔投资很可能还是会落实。但如果有人指望英伟达在必要时出手救助 CoreWeave，恐怕得另找靠山了。”不过，乔治城大学麦克多诺商学院副教授杰森 · 施洛策认为，英伟达最近遭遇的风波，以及外界对黄仁勋判断力的质疑，也可能让合作伙伴受到更严格的审查。他预计，市场将更加仔细地审视 Anthropic 与英伟达及英伟达客户之间的联系。在硅谷，Anthropic 和竞争对手 OpenAI 的融资需求极其庞大，几乎所有风投公司都持有两家公司的股份，使两家公司在私募市场上的地位近似于指数基金。因此，Anthropic 预计下周进行的 IPO 将成为一场举足轻重的投资变现机会，不仅关系到超过 400 名投资者的利益，也关系到整个 AI 热潮的前景。市场普遍认为，如果 Anthropic 成功上市，AI 热潮就还有很大的发展空间；如果上市失败或无限期推迟，则将明确释放出 AI 泡沫接近破裂的负面信号。不过，黄仁勋离职未必会让 Anthropic 上市受挫。至少有一名风险投资人认为，Anthropic 反而可能受益。双方在 AI 监管方面也有分歧，黄仁勋尤其反对可能增加客户使用开源 AI 模型难度的许可要求。一名匿名风险投资人认为：“真要说有什么影响，我反而觉得 Anthropic 会从中受益。他们跟黄仁勋的关系本来就没那么密切……Anthropic 还在开发自己的芯片，因此供应链方面腾出的空间对他们有利。”

articles.title: AI 助力复活尘封 15 年废案，iOS 4 时代苹果卡片后台界面曝光
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，据外媒 AppleInsider 今天（13 日）晚间报道，借助 AI 和模拟器技术，一套尘封超过 15 年、从未正式发布的 iPhone 多任务切换界面重新跑了起来。2010 年初，该媒体曾报道苹果测试一套类似 Exposé 窗口总览功能的界面的消息。2011 年，有人在一台 iPhone 4 原型机上发现了搭载这套界面的特殊版本 iOS 4。此后十多年，这套卡片式多任务界面始终无人公开演示，直到一名模拟器开发者借助 AI，让被苹果放弃的设计重见天日。开发者史蒂夫 · 特劳顿-史密斯在 Mastodon 上分享了一段视频，展示这套从未发布的界面。视频中的 iOS 4 运行在 QEMU 模拟器的一个分支版本上，系统版本号为此前未曾公开的 8A218，比 2011 年发现的 8A216 版本略晚。开发者向 AppleInsider 介绍说：“借助 AI 辅助开发的模拟器，现在任何能找到的旧版 iOS 都可以运行起来。”从现有信息判断，这个罕见的 iOS 版本预计是提取自一台原型机，而不是苹果内部的系统恢复包。有人从开发设备或 iPhone 原型机中提取了根文件系统，再借助 ChatGPT，让系统成功在 QEMU 模拟器中启动。视频展示了苹果开发 iOS 4 时尝试的 Exposé 式多任务界面。所有打开的应用都以卡片形式排列在屏幕上，呈现出九宫格式布局。用户连按两次 Home 键，就能直接选择想要切换的应用，无需滚动浏览。IT之家注：在如今常见的卡片式应用切换界面问世前，iPhone 曾采用从屏幕底部滑出的抽屉式菜单切换应用。

articles.title: 韩国拟采购无线电探测设备，防范国家资格考试“AI 作弊”
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，据新华社报道，由于担心考生利用 AI 眼镜等高科技设备在国家资格考试中作弊，韩国正考虑采取应对措施。韩国最大在野党国民力量党议员金渭相近日提议，在 2027 年度预算中增加约 65.7 亿韩元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 3,286.3 万元人民币）经费，用于采购无线电信号探测设备并安排专职人员，防范国家资格考试中的 AI 作弊行为。韩国国会此前已关注到高科技作弊问题。负责组织国家资格考试的韩国产业人力公团随后估算了所需经费，提出花费 36 亿韩元（现汇率约合 1,800.7 万元人民币）采购 7200 台无线电信号探测设备，投入 29.7 亿韩元（现汇率约合 1,485.6 万元人民币）安排 23559 名负责识别高科技作弊的专职人员。有关预算增拨方案尚需经过国会审议。韩国产业人力公团表示，AI 眼镜外观与普通眼镜相似，监考人员通过肉眼识别难度大，引入无线电信号探测设备有助于提高监考实效。数据显示，截至 10 月底，韩国今年举行的国家资格考试中已查获 6 起涉及智能眼镜的作弊案件。韩国将于 19 日举行大学修学能力考试（即高考）。今年 7 月，韩国教育部已将 AI 眼镜列入考场禁带物品清单。为防范相关作弊行为，韩国教育部门近期对监考人员开展专项培训，全国 1312 个考点均将配备至少 1 名专门负责识别 AI 眼镜的监考人员。由于尚无专用探测设备，今年高考主要依靠目视检查。韩国教育部警告，在高考中使用 AI 眼镜作弊的考生，可能面临多至 3 年禁考处罚，并被追究刑事责任。

articles.content: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，历时 14 天的第二届华为乾崑智驾公开赛今日正式收官。本届赛事自 10 月 31 日开赛以来，吸引了超过 19 万名车主报名参与，赛事围绕真实出行场景设置八大赛道，覆盖城市通勤、乡道漫游、高速领航、停车泊车等多个环节。与传统竞技赛事不同，本届公开赛将“赛道即日常”的理念融入比赛，让车主在真实道路中体验辅助驾驶，从复杂园区、盘山道路到极窄路段，从城市通勤到郊野出行，多样化的道路环境，也让华为乾崑智驾 ADS 5 的能力得到了更充分的展示。对于日常驾驶来说，城市主干道只是出行的一部分，复杂环岛、没有清晰标线的乡间小路，以及老城区里的狭窄道路，同样是车主经常遇到的情况。本届赛事将这些非标准路况纳入体验范围。此外，华为乾崑智驾 ADS 5 还新增了城区漫游巡航辅助 RCA。不同于需要提前规划路线的传统领航辅助，该功能无需设置目的地，也不必开启导航，即可在城区道路开启漫游巡航，支持红绿灯识别、路口连续通行以及自主变道、超车等操作。进入园区后，用户同样可以开启漫游巡航辅助，并根据需要就近选择空闲车位泊车。停车也是本届赛事关注的重点。针对车位被占、通道狭窄等日常停车难题，华为乾崑智驾 ADS 5 车位到车位 3.0 支持车位与路边之间自由切换。如果抵达停车场后发现原定车位已被占用，系统还可以继续漫游寻找其他空闲车位。与此同时，守位泊车、手势泊车以及即插即充等功能也被纳入体验范围。其中，即插即充支持车辆停入充电车位后，通过插入充电枪直接启动充电，无需再进行扫码操作。安全方面，本届赛事设置了安全挑战赛道，重点体验华为乾崑智驾 ADS 5 的防御性安全能力。其新增的后向主动防撞辅助，在城区快速路或高速行驶时，如果后方车辆近距离逼近、存在追尾风险，系统会在判断前方环境安全后主动加速，以降低被追尾的风险。从城区到郊野，从道路领航到车位到车位 3.0，本届公开赛将辅助驾驶体验融入车主日常出行的多个环节。19 万车主的参与，也让华为乾崑智驾 ADS 5 在真实道路中的能力得到了一次集中展示。对于辅助驾驶而言，技术实力不仅体现在功能和参数上，更体现在面对复杂多变的道路环境时，能否为用户带来稳定、可靠的出行体验。这也是本届华为乾崑智驾公开赛将赛场搬到真实道路上的重要意义。

articles.title: 英伟达博客发声：她不一样，她懂显卡 ( bushi )，她懂端到端！
articles.content: 她叫Alpamayo 2 Edge，因果推理结合扩散动作，端到端输出闭环表现提升 48.9%。    作者丨郑佳美    编辑丨岑   峰                                                                                                       点开前，你以为老黄家的惊天大瓜又有了什么后续； 点开后才发现：这个“她”连人都不是。她叫 Alpamayo 2 Edge。 英伟达11月10日刚发布出来的一款端到端自动驾驶模型。VLM 骨干约 2.45B、动作专家约 0.2B，跑在车规级芯片 DRIVE AGX Thor 上。但“懂端到端”这四个字，还真不是标题党蹭流量。在各路AI疯狂“嘴替”、大模型疯狂自言自语的时代，英伟达力挺的这姑娘（划掉）这模型，是真·人间清醒。Alpamayo 2 Edge希望让汽车里的 AI 不仅能看懂道路，还能理解复杂交通关系、分析潜在风险，并根据场景自主生成驾驶动作。简单来说，就是让 AI 从会看、会理解，进一步走向会开车。当然，让 AI 在服务器里推理和让它在高速行驶的汽车里推理，完全是两回事。车载算力有限，响应时间也有严格要求，模型既要具备复杂场景下的推理能力，又不能把大量计算资源消耗在冗长的思考过程中。Alpamayo 2 Edge 围绕这个问题做了一套新的设计：普通端到端模型输入图像直接输出轨迹，中间发生了什么是黑箱。而 Alpamayo 2 Edge 被强制要求生成 Chain-of-Causation（因果链）推理：不光要开车，还要说出为什么这么开。所以汽车究竟需要怎样“懂端到端”的 AI，才能既想得明白，又开得及时？这套新 VLA 给出了一个颇有意思的技术方案。01让模型自主控制推理开销Alpamayo 2 Edge 的一个核心设计，是让模型学习何时需要展开完整推理。自回归语言模型下推理文本越长，生成耗时越高，而车载系统还需要为视觉编码和轨迹生成预留计算资源。NVIDIA 为此引入了 Adaptive Reasoning，并设计特殊标记 <NOMINAL>。当模型判断当前属于常规驾驶状态时，可以直接输出这个标记，结束显式推理文本的生成；遇到复杂交通交互时，再生成完整的 Chain-of-Causation（CoC）推理链。这里有一个重要的实现细节：<NOMINAL>并不意味着关闭视觉网络，也不代表模型跳过后续动作计算。它改变的是语言模型的输出方式，减少常规场景下的推理 Token。公开架构没有披露独立的外置风险分类器，模型需要通过训练学会两种输出模式的选择。那么，模型如何知道什么场景需要推理？这涉及 CoC 的数据构建。NVIDIA 的自动标注流程会先从车辆轨迹中提取 Meta-Action，也就是自车的高层运动行为，再根据行为发生变化的时间点定位关键帧，随后调用 VLM 生成场景因素与驾驶动作之间的因果解释。标注还需要经过验证，检查解释是否有画面依据，以及描述的动作是否符合实际轨迹。这里有一个重要的设计取舍：驾驶视频中存在大量连续画面，但并非每一帧都会产生新的驾驶决策。如果逐帧生成推理文本，训练集容易积累大量重复描述。以 Meta-Action 变化为锚点，可以把监督集中在车辆行为发生变化的时刻，让模型学习障碍物、交通参与者和道路条件如何影响自车动作。NVIDIA 使用 Alpamayo 2 Super 生成 CoC 自动标注，再通过离线蒸馏训练 Edge 模型。公开数据约包含 115,000 小时多摄像头驾驶视频，以及 370 万条 CoC 推理标注。例如，前方车辆减速时，模型需要结合左侧来车、道路边界和自身速度判断是否能够绕行。CoC 要表达这些因素与减速、等待或转向之间的联系，同时避免引用决策发生之后才出现的信息。这样，模型学习的内容包含两层：复杂场景下如何组织因果解释，以及常规场景下何时可以省去显式解释。前者提供驾驶推理监督，后者控制文本生成成本。不过，自动生成的 CoC 仍可能继承教师模型的偏差，解

articles.title: Back to Pixels: Lifting Latent Video Diffusion into Pixel Space
articles.content: Frontier video generation models work in a VAE latent space that compresses video in both space and time. This compression made training tractable, but now limits high-resolution, controllable, and interactive generation -- doubling resolution quadruples token count, conditions apply to groups of frames rather than individual ones, and each response must wait for the rest of its multi-frame block. We present PixVid, a simple yet effective method that lifts a pretrained latent video model to directly generate every frame in pixel space. PixVid keeps the diffusion transformer and replaces the VAE decoder with a convolutional head that renders its outputs into pixels. We find that predicting clean video rather than velocity, together with a larger noise shift, is key to quality. Finetuned from Wan2.1-14B, PixVid is competitive with the latent baseline within $\sim 1.3$M training clips. Working framewise in pixels, it generates at $2\times$ higher resolution with the same per-frame token count, keeps depth-conditioned video editing aligned under fast motion, and responds to each action at the next frame. Project page: https://chenshuo20.github.io/PixVid/

articles.title: Unbundling Multimodal Vision Encoding
articles.content: How multimodal language models should encode visual input remains up for debate. Most models use a pretrained vision encoder, while some recent recipes train the encoder from scratch with the language model or remove it entirely. Vision encoders bundle together three design choices: a visual prior from upstream pretraining, dedicated vision capacity, and pre-fusion placement of that capacity (i.e., before the multimodal backbone). Because published models also differ in data, architecture, and compute, comparing them cannot isolate the effect of each choice. We disentangle these choices via a controlled framework where we pretrain all models from scratch on common data and compare them on visual question answering and language benchmarks at matched lifetime compute. We find that the visual prior is not necessary; an encoder trained jointly from scratch is on par with a pretrained one, without a separate training stage. What matters instead is dedicated vision capacity: an encoder-free model trails on visual understanding even when its backbone is enlarged by the encoder's parameter count. Yet that capacity need not precede multimodal fusion, as vision-only modules added in-fusion to early backbone layers perform comparably to a pre-fusion encoder and can lower time to first token. These results also hold across backbone sizes, when encoder pretraining is treated as free, and when starting from a pretrained language model. Overall, our findings favor dedicated vision capacity trained jointly with the backbone and placed early within it.

articles.title: TTB: Test-time Baking for Efficient Rendering of Decoder-only View Synthesis Models
articles.content: Decoder-only Large View Synthesis Models (LVSMs) with KV-cache have recently achieved state-of-the-art quality by regressing novel views from neural networks without reconstructing 3D geometry, while Test-Time Training (TTT) layers save computation but sacrifice quality. We propose Test-Time Baking (TTB), a strategy that learns to bake global scene information from cross-view attention into a lightweight MLP, enabling fast and high-fidelity novel-view decoding. The first key is to repurpose the fast-weight MLP of TTT to learn the cross-view attention mapping explicitly from its input-output pairs, rather than replacing attention entirely, achieving the same rendering efficiency as TTT while delivering substantially higher quality. The second key addresses a modality misalignment between context prefilling and novel-view rendering: we disentangle context tokens into camera-only context rendering tokens to serve as TTB input, and context ground-truth tokens with image content to serve as the TTB mapping target, ensuring the baked MLPs are relieved of the modality generalization challenge between context and novel-view processing. Our method achieves up to **23x** rendering speedup with quality on par with the state-of-the-art across several benchmarks. Project page: https://test-time-baking.github.io

articles.title: ArchSpace: Recording, Reviewing, and Referencing LLM Architecture Research
articles.content: Model architecture shapes the scaling behavior, training efficiency, and inference cost of LLMs, making it a central focus of both industry and academia. In industry, teams such as those behind DeepSeek, Qwen, and Kimi routinely introduce architectural innovations, yet public reports rarely document which ideas succeeded, which were abandoned, and why. In academia, limited compute and inconsistent baselines often restrict evaluations to small-scale, single-point comparisons, making it difficult to establish whether improvements hold at larger scales or translate into broader impact. ArchSpace addresses both gaps as a public platform for Recording, Reviewing, and Referencing Architecture Researc}: each proposal is recorded with its experiments and reasoning, reviewed by the community, and referenced by later work. To evaluate ideas before costly large-scale training, ArchSpace leverages scaling laws to predict model loss at larger scales from smaller experiments, a practice widely adopted in industry. We provide initial references that make the platform usable: Qwen3.5 and OLMo3 baselines, fitted scaling laws, and a reusable training recipe. Ideas validated through this review can in turn become new baselines, and ArchSpace thereby aims to broaden the range of ideas that shape the next generation of models.

articles.title: ProtoVis-Nav: Prototypical Visual Imagination for Visual-Spatial Aligned UAV Navigation
articles.content: Vision language navigation (VLN) is very challenging for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) since small errors in 3D motion prediction can lead to navigation errors and collisions. Unable to fathom execution outcomes in 3D environments, existing methods often struggle to predict accurate navigation waypoints from language instructions. To solve this, we introduce the Prototypical Visual Imagination framework, shortened as ProtoVis-Nav, which forces the model to imagine an outcome-associated local visual representation for the intended next UAV movement. Specifically, we predict feature prototypes and use their linear combination to estimate the visual feature of the target region. In this manner, the VLN model first imagines the local visual representation of the next intended location, and then uses predicted prototypes as context for generating the final action, promoting alignment between visual context and waypoint outputs. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the ProtoVis-Nav framework and show substantial improvements over existing baselines.

articles.title: Internalizing Investment Mandates: A Neurosymbolic RL Approach to Portfolio Allocation
articles.content: Institutional portfolios operate under investment policy statements that specify asset allocation constraints, often conditioned on market regime information. Deep reinforcement learning has been shown to optimize financial performance but typically does not enforce rule compliance, making it unsuitable for real-world deployment. Existing neurosymbolic methods such as Probabilistic Logic Policy Gradient (PLPG) offer constraint-satisfying reinforcement learning (RL) via differentiable symbolic supervision but assume a finite, discrete action space. We present a PLPG-inspired continuous allocation method that estimates the probability that the policy's own executed action satisfies the investment mandate, using reparameterized Monte Carlo sampling, and adds it to the training objective. No post-hoc enforcement mechanism intercepts actions at inference time and compliance is learned by the agent. Audited directly on deterministic mean actions with no correction, the policy reduces violations of a six-rule regime-conditional mandate from 96-98% for unconstrained RL and 33.4% for a reward-penalty baseline to 4.8%, showing that a continuous-action neurosymbolic policy can substantially internalize a symbolic mandate.

articles.title: K2V: Generative Keyframing For Physically Plausible Video Generation
articles.content: Video diffusion models are able to generate samples with high-quality appearance and textural qualities. However, content produced by these methods is known to exhibit significant physical errors. This is because, in a classical video generation setting, all physical reasoning must take place simultaneously and exclusively within the diffusion process.We propose to resolve these issues by redistributing the task of physical reasoning onto a language model-backed keyframe generation module, which allows for explicit reasoning in language, and fine-grained control over the appearance of the video at important moments in the video. We then condition a video generation model with these keyframes, reducing the role of the diffusion model to the simpler task of interpolating between physically-correct intermediate states, rather than inferring an entire sequence with diffusion. Results demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms existing approaches, achieving state-of-the-art performance on the Physics-IQ Verified benchmark and PhyGenBench.

articles.title: AgentSSL: Can MLE Agents Leverage Unlabeled Data?
articles.content: Applying machine learning systems to new domains introduces bottlenecks in both labeled data acquisition and manual pipeline engineering. While recent MLE agents show promise in automating pipeline design, they have been studied almost exclusively in fully supervised settings, leaving them untested in realistic regimes where labeled data is scarce but unlabeled data is abundant. In this work, we introduce Agentic Semi-Supervised Learning (AgentSSL), framing SSL as a program search problem and studying how agents navigate this space under limited supervision. We find that even under weak feedback and matched compute, agents can synthesize code that combines and adapts established SSL techniques, exceeding the strongest human-engineered baselines in 8 of 12 settings by up to +21.8%. However, our results identify program selection as a critical bottleneck in AgentSSL, where performance drops by as much as 47% when selecting based on the agent's feedback metric. To systematically study this bottleneck, we introduce ProgramSelectBench, a large-scale benchmark with a combined total of 16,977 agent-generated and human-engineered SSL programs, and evaluate both unsupervised and active program selection methods. We further evaluate AgentSSL on real-world ecology detection tasks, highlighting the opportunities and challenges of transferring agent-discovered strategies beyond controlled benchmarks.

articles.title: BrickFlow: Connectivity-Guided Brick Reconstruction
articles.content: Given a set of LEGO parts and an image of an assembled object, our task is to infer the pose of each part to assemble the object. In contrast with traditional 3D reconstruction, doing so requires satisfying discrete physical constraints, which provide structure but render the problem combinatorial and highly sensitive to small pose errors. To learn a prior over how parts fit together, we train a set-conditioned SE(3) flow model on procedurally generated assemblies. We then finetune this model to inject image conditioning, using 1% as much data. However, while the learned flow captures global structure, it does not enforce connectivity. To address this, we introduce an analytic connectivity-field guidance to pull predictions toward connected assemblies at test time. Through this, we demonstrate improved build quality with model size, pretraining, and guidance. We make our models and data available for research purposes at https://kulits.github.io/BrickFlow/

articles.title: Learning When Diffusion Language Models Should Regenerate
articles.content: Remasking allows diffusion language models to revisit generated text, but effective correction requires knowing when and what to revise. Our diagnosis on Sudoku reveals two gaps. Hidden states contain error information that token confidence does not reliably expose, and remasking an isolated error usually reproduces it when the surrounding context remains fixed. These findings motivate DiVR , a verifier that predicts whether a partially generated sequence will reach a correct answer. Trained on the final correctness of the model's own trajectories, DiVR decides when to regenerate a block and which alternative to retain, while the generator itself stays unchanged. On five reasoning benchmarks with LLaDA-8B-Base, DiVR raises the average accuracy of the fine-tuned generator from 35.3\% to 43.4\% at $1.9$-$3.5\times$ the cost of greedy decoding, above search baselines that use $3.8$-$7.4\times$. It also complements post-training such as supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, and generalizes to other generators, including Dream.

articles.title: Spatial Foundry: A Multimodal Dataset for Spatial Intelligence
articles.content: Spatial intelligence requires connecting visual observations to the geometry, objects, and persistent state of an environment. Images alone leave these relationships implicit, while disconnected annotations make it difficult to study appearance, camera motion, and scene changes under a common reference. We introduce Spatial Foundry, a collection of 5,280 furnished residential 3D scene configurations with editable assets and aligned visual, geometric, and temporal data. Its modalities include floor plans, perspective and panoramic RGB, metric depth, point clouds, meshes, instance-level 3D bounding boxes, and camera trajectories paired with video. Shared scene coordinates link observations across views and time; editable source scenes enable additional camera paths and controlled object changes. We describe the data representation and construction workflow, and discuss applications in floor-plan-conditioned 3D generation, geometric reconstruction, instance-level perception, camera-conditioned video generation, shared world modeling, and scene editing. Controlled camera and scene variations support spatial perception and world-model research. The public project page provides videos and an interactive colored point-cloud preview.

articles.title: CoReMem: Cost-Internalizing Memory for Successive Coding Tasks with Prospective Valuation
articles.content: Coding agents tackle successive tasks on an evolving repository, carrying forward edits and writing memory before the next task is known. Selecting memory for unknown next tasks requires balancing future usefulness against the costs of writing and reading it. The actor must also decide when acting on available memory saves effort as the task unfolds. We introduce Coding-Repository Memory (CoReMem), a cost-internalizing framework that guides memory design and actor adaptation through measured memory value on the next task. Prospective segment valuation compares runs of the next task with and without individual trajectory segments from the same inherited repository state, guiding a compact memory built around anchors: repository locations and executable checks. Actor adaptation estimates on-policy memory value within rollout groups with and without memory, using a reward that prioritizes resolution and penalizes step count in successful runs. Provenance-gated value credit assigns the additional value term to steps identified as using memory-supplied anchors, while every step retains outcome credit. On ChainSWE, CoReMem raises the 27B actor's resolve rate from 21.0% to 25.7%, with 17% fewer steps and 11% fewer total cache-aware tokens, including memory-module calls, relative to the untrained actor model without memory.

articles.title: Linking Rapid Learning to Compositional Structure in Neural Networks: Evidence from Additive Analogies in Meta-Learned Parameter Spaces
articles.content: Humans can learn rapidly from limited experience, while neural networks typically require extensive training. In this work, we investigate what properties of a neural network can enable it to learn rapidly. We study neural networks that have been optimized via meta-learning, a technique that exposes a network to many related functions to facilitate its subsequent learning of similar functions. Prior work has shown that these meta-learned networks can learn new functions rapidly, but how they do so remains unclear. To investigate their internal structure, we take inspiration from classic work demonstrating additive relationships among the learned vectors that neural networks use to represent words (e.g., "king" minus "man" plus "woman" approximates "queen"). Analogously, we look for additive relationships among a meta-learned network's "representations" of different functions; when a meta-learned network rapidly learns to implement a specific function, all of its adapted parameter values can be concatenated into a single vector that we treat as representing the function. We find that such parameter vectors can be added and subtracted according to symbolic relationships among the functions they represent, yielding new parameter vectors that successfully represent the functions predicted by the corresponding symbolic manipulations: the networks specified by these artificially recombined vectors actually implement the intended functions without any direct training on them. Our results suggest that meta-learning can tune a network's starting point to organize subsequent learning along systematic, functionally meaningful trajectories through the space of possible parameter vectors, providing a geometric basis for realizing inductive biases in neural networks.

articles.title: Sketching Language Models for Context Attribution
articles.content: Context attribution asks how removing parts of a prompt changes a language model's output. We study leave-one-out (LOO) attribution for a prompt of $n$ tokens and a fixed measurement function. Computing all LOO values directly requires $n$ model evaluations. Under a stability assumption, our algorithm estimates all LOO values to error proportional to $\varepsilon$ with constant probability using $O(\sqrt{\log(1/\varepsilon)}/\varepsilon)$ evaluation calls. To complement our upper bound, we prove a matching $Ω(\sqrt{\log(1/\varepsilon)}/\varepsilon)$ lower bound on the number of evaluation calls in an oracle model. Empirically, we verify coefficient decay consistent with stability and evaluate the performance of our sketching algorithm on a small language-model retrieval task.   Technically, our result is based on a sketching algorithm for arithmetic circuits whose Taylor coefficients satisfy the stability condition recently introduced by Gunn [Gun26]. A direct adaptation of their forward differentiation sketches would require $\widetilde{O}(\log(n)/\varepsilon^2)$ evaluation calls. Our key observation is that we can apply forward differentiation to the backpropagation circuit, with only constant overhead over a forward sketch of the same Taylor degree. This reduces the variance of the sketches and is key to our improved evaluation bound. Our lower bound builds on the techniques of Amsel, Chen, Duman Keles, Halikias, Musco, and Musco [ACDH+26, SIAM Journal on Matrix Analysis and Applications] for lower bounding the number of matrix-vector queries to estimate the diagonal elements of random matrices.

articles.title: Classical Energies Learn to Reason 1,000x Faster than Looped Models
articles.content: Looped models have emerged as a prominent paradigm for reasoning, with successes on simple reasoning puzzles such as Sudoku-Extreme and Maze-Unique. However, these models can be unstable, slow to train, and use many parameters and FLOPs to solve simple puzzles. Descent on an energy not only mitigates these issues but also offers advantages: built-in early stopping, compute that adapts to problem difficulty, fast training without differentiating through a solver, and interpretable weights that learn the constraints of the puzzle. Here we demonstrate this with a learned version of Hopfield & Tank's energy from the 80s, which we term CRAM, solves 99.996% of Sudoku-Extreme and 100% of Maze-Unique test puzzles after 42 ms and 132 ms of training on one GPU, at least 1,000x faster than looped models on these tasks. CRAM also matches baseline looped models at their highest accuracy on Sudoku-Extreme using at least 282x fewer inference FLOPs. Our work suggests two things. First, that energies are an extremely promising direction for training reasoning from data. Second, a caution against using trivially solvable benchmarks like Sudoku and Maze to test the scalability of looped reasoning techniques.

articles.title: Quantifying structural stability of transparent models for general insurance pricing
articles.content: The short duration of general insurance contracts leads to rapid distributional shifts in the data, warranting regular model updates. This process may yield a post-update model that differs considerably from the pre-update model in both predictions and structure. Structural stability is upstream of predictive stability, yet existing structural stability metrics are mostly restricted to simple decision trees. Thus, we first introduce the notion of functional transparency, characterising models with a prediction function that can be expressed as a sum of univariate functions for main effects and bivariate functions for pairwise interactions. Then, we propose the Mean Squared Shape function distance, a metric to quantify the structural stability of functionally transparent models, which are particularly relevant in actuarial science. Using three public auto insurance datasets, we present a benchmark study to demonstrate the usefulness of our metric in identifying a stable and accurate transparent model. Generalised linear models with centred numerical covariates are stable, and explainable boosting machines (EBMs) offer a compromise between stability and performance. We also find that stabilisation strategies, such as sequential modelling and fixed hyperparameters, can substantially improve stability for both EBM and XGBoost models, with negligible impact on performance.

articles.title: Towards a Theory of Learnability via Debate
articles.content: Debate has been recently proposed as a training protocol that is hoped to produce more aligned models even as model capabilities scale. The idea is that the human, instead of providing supervision in the form of labels, judges a debate between two models that compete to prove the correctness of opposite labels. It can be shown that functions of a much higher computational complexity can be correctly judged in this way, compared to the complexity of functions that can be directly evaluated using a computationally weak evaluator. This suggests that perhaps debate can be used to teach very complicated functions to models. However, previous work has largely ignored the fact that this is a training protocol, and simply analyzes the game being played between the two debaters for a known judge. We take the first steps towards understanding the learning problem implicit within the protocol, by formulating it as an online learning problem. We show that once we formulate the learning problem precisely, there are cases where the best way to learn given access to a judge is different from running an adversarial debate. This motivates us to define a cooperative version of the protocol, whose learnability we characterize using a combinatorial dimension. We also consider the possibility of the human judge being fallible and occasionally judging the debate incorrectly. We show that a small number of errors in judgement can lead to a large error in learning.

articles.title: FLEX-LBP: Learning Local Binary Patterns with Exact Binary Inference for Texture Classification
articles.content: Local Binary Patterns (LBP) remain among the most widely used texture descriptors, from industrial inspection to medical imaging. Yet their radius, sampling angles, color transform and thresholds are fixed by hand for each dataset. We present FLEX-LBP, which learns these parameters by backpropagation while every forward pass computes exact binary codes and hard histogram counts. A straight-through estimator acts only in the backward pass, so the deployed descriptor is an interpretable hard-binary LBP with 90 learnable parameters and unchanged inference cost. In a controlled ablation on six color texture benchmarks, the component worth learning is dataset-dependent. One configuration, applied unchanged everywhere, learns the geometry and thresholds with the color transform frozen. It improves the nearest-neighbor accuracy of the identical fixed descriptor by 3.55 points on average over five seeds, significantly on five of six benchmarks and never significantly worse. With a linear discriminant readout, it gains 0.9 points; the fully learned descriptor gains 2.7 and has the highest mean. FLEX-LBP is more accurate than five classical LBP-family descriptors, PCANet and a neural LBP on five of six benchmarks. Its mean nearest-neighbor accuracy exceeds that of frozen ImageNet ResNet-50 features (23.5 million parameters). On the Kather colorectal cancer histology benchmark, the fully learned descriptor reaches 93.8%, significantly above the best classical descriptor (Completed LBP, 92.8%). The learned radii adapt in directions that recur across seeds. Noise drowns single-pixel comparisons and illuminant change flips inter-channel ones; median sampling or gray-world normalization restores 96-97%. The code is available as a drop-in PyTorch layer at https://github.com/medalimoussa/FLEX-LBP.

articles.title: Consistent Video-to-Video Translation via Explicit Correspondences
articles.content: Interactive video-to-video applications require real-time generation while maintaining long-range temporal consistency. However, recent methods achieve speed by restricting attention to a fixed-length causal window. This limits long-range consistency whenever relevant history falls outside the context window. To address this limitation, we introduce vid2vid-long, a correspondence-based approach grounded in a simple observation. Video-to-video translation provides an explicit cross-frame reference: the regions that match in the input video should match in the output video too. Concretely, we compute patch-level correspondences in the input, guiding retrieval of previously generated outputs in the corresponding regions, and condition the model on these patches through correspondence cross-attention. Our experiments demonstrate that vid2vid-long consistently improves long-range temporal consistency across recent video models while preserving generation quality and real-time performance.

articles.title: Goal Encoding in LLMs
articles.content: We investigate whether and how LLMs encode goals: internal neural representations that precede and guide action, and that are flexible enough to be realized through many different execution paths. We construct a coding setting with multiple sub-tasks that allows us to evaluate goal-seeking behavior and the selection of sub-goals. In this setting, we localize an encoding of the next sub-goal in the outputs of a sparse set of attention heads. The same heads can be used to decode the LM's future actions in natural language (e.g., "I'm checking if a word is a palindrome"). We verify that this encoding is causal for next action and is plastic: transplanting it into a different environment, e.g., another programming language, triggers the same operation realized with a different sequence of tokens. The LM also sustains the encoding throughout the action's execution, which is puzzling because a transformer LM without recurrence cannot carry a state forward for more tokens than it has layers left. We propose that it does not need to. Under a non-recurrent goal-seeking (NRGS) account, the LM frequently re-reads the goal from the task specification, compares it with the progress visible in the growing context, and pursues what remains. We test the predictions of this account with targeted causal interventions.

articles.title: Metal Sandbox: Isolated Execution and Command Scheduling for GPU Coding Agents on Apple Silicon
articles.content: On-device inference requires kernels that make effective use of local accelerators. Efficient training and evaluation of models that generate Apple Metal kernels benefit from native macOS tools and concurrent agent sessions. These sessions alternate between model requests, development commands, and GPU execution, leaving GPU capacity idle for much of a rollout. We present Metal Sandbox, infrastructure that combines restricted per-instance file access, native command execution, and command-level scheduling across interconnected Macs. Each agent retains its workspace and private development environment. Parallel commands can run concurrently, while serial commands share one execution slot per node; eligible waiting commands can migrate to available Macs and return results to the original agent. Integration with Harbor supports task execution, automatic verification, and rollout collection through a common workflow. Controlled experiments on four Mac mini M4 nodes achieve $1.68\times$--$2.05\times$ gains in command throughput under concentrated demand. Sixteen static agent traces give an estimated $2.14\times$ sustained-throughput gain for four sessions per node versus one, assuming continuously replenished sessions and unchanged mean durations. Replaying these measured traces under dynamic scheduling reduces mean tool waiting by 18.8% and batch elapsed time by 22.3%, assuming unchanged phase durations. Metal Sandbox and its Harbor integration are open-source on GitHub.

articles.title: Negative-Only Policy Optimization for One-Sided Verifiable Rewards
articles.content: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) typically relies on a verifier that can reliably judge whether sampled solutions are correct. However, in many realistic settings, complete verification is generally unavailable, while cheap checks can only falsify failures. We formalize this regime as one-sided verifiability (OSV): verified negatives are reliable counterexamples, but verified positives are merely non-falsified candidates and may contain many false positives. This asymmetry makes standard RLVR unreliable, because reinforcing verified positives can directly reward shortcuts that pass partial checks. To address this issue, we propose Negative-Only Policy Optimization (NOPO), which treats verified positives as unlabeled and updates the policy only by suppressing trusted verified negatives. Specifically, NOPO combines a reference-relative negative suppression loss with a group-level adapter that scales each update by the proportion of non-falsified responses. Across unit-test, constraint-check, and LLM self-verifiers, NOPO improves pass@k over baselines on code, logic, and math benchmarks when oracle rewards are unavailable. These gains persist under inference-time scaling and cross-benchmark transfer.

articles.title: Synthesis Smuggling: Maliciously Hiding Inferred Personal Attributes in LLM Outputs
articles.content: We propose Synthesis Smuggling, a novel threat model in which an adversarial LLM infers sensitive information about a user from routine assistance-seeking interactions and steganographically encodes that into innocuous-looking model-generated content. The user may then unknowingly transmit that information by sharing the generated artifact, say as an email, social-media post, or message, through ordinary communication channels. An adversary monitoring these channels can discover this information. We demonstrate this threat by training two open-weight models to infer gender and age-group labels from conversational cues and encode their predictions using invisible characters or word choices. These results show that user-shared model outputs can become a covert channel for personal inferences, even when the model itself has no direct means of contacting an adversary.

articles.title: LiveGeo: Benchmarking Geographic Agents in Continuously Evolving Worlds
articles.content: We introduce GeoWorld, a controllable and continuously evolving geographic environment platform for LLM agents, and LiveGeo, a benchmark for evaluating reliable decision-making in real-world geographic environments using GeoWorld. Unlike existing evaluations that largely reason and plan over fixed geographic states, GeoWorld is grounded in real-world geographic structure and allows external world states to evolve along their own temporal processes while preserving verifiable state histories. LiveGeo places geographic tasks within this evolving environment, requiring agents to actively acquire task-relevant information, verify whether the evidence supporting prior decisions remains valid, and revise their plans when necessary. Our results reveal that even frontier LLMs struggle with static tasks, with no model consistently excelling across tasks, while strong static performance does not ensure dynamic reliability. Further analysis identifies a key bottleneck: agents struggle to acquire and translate relevant evidence into valid decisions and maintain their correctness as the world evolves. By releasing LiveGeo together with its GeoWorld platform, we aim to provide the community with a flexible and extensible infrastructure for studying the next generation of agents capable of reliable action in evolving geographic worlds.

articles.title: Programming Quantum Circuit Parameters with Large Language Models
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) have recently demonstrated the ability to generate parameters for variational quantum circuits without conventional optimization. However, the conditions under which this approach is effective remain unclear. Here, we investigate a frozen, general-purpose LLM that generates complete circuit parameter vectors from symbolic circuit and Hamiltonian descriptions, with optional iterative energy feedback. We evaluate the approach on general random Hamiltonians, structured parent Hamiltonians, and molecular systems. For general Hamiltonians, LLM-generated parameters exhibit larger energy errors than conventional Adam optimization, while additional feedback generally provides limited improvement. In contrast, for structured Hamiltonians, the LLM can generate promising low-energy parameter configurations, suggesting that identifiable physical and mathematical structure facilitates parameter inference. We also show that direct LLM predictions of minimum energies can violate the Hamiltonian spectral lower bound, whereas generated circuit parameters allow independent evaluation of physically realizable energy expectation values. Finally, we investigate blind circuit interpretation and find that the LLM can predict measurement outcomes even when it fails to identify the underlying quantum algorithm. These findings highlight the role of problem structure, the limitations of iterative LLM optimization, and the importance of independently verifiable predictions in quantum parameter programming.

articles.title: Ballad: Bandit-Based LLM Routing for Automated Heuristic Discovery
articles.content: Modern automated heuristic discovery (AHD) systems increasingly rival hand-crafted heuristics by leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) to iteratively mutate and refine solutions. A natural assumption is that more powerful and more expensive models consistently yield better heuristics. We challenge this empirically: across multiple NP-hard combinatorial optimization problems, we find no consistent advantage for larger, costlier models. This raises a deeper question: given a pool of LLMs spanning frontier and freely hosted or open-weight models, how should one adaptively select which model to invoke at each step of the search? The challenge is non-trivial. The optimal LLM may shift over the course of a run, and because one LLM's output seeds the context for subsequent calls, each model's reward signal is non-stationary and entangled across the heuristic population, thus violating the independence assumptions of classical online decision-making settings. We address this through Ballad (Bandit-based LLM Routing for Automated Heuristic Discovery), an online bandit algorithm that learns to orchestrate a pool of LLMs into an ensemble that matches or exceeds what any soloist LLM achieves alone. This orchestration is powered by an LLM selection policy that favors rare, high-scoring heuristics over stable averages, a DAG-based credit propagation mechanism through the genealogy of the heuristic population, and discounting of stale observations to remain attuned to each model's current utility. Across five NP-hard combinatorial optimization problems and a pool of four models of varying capability and cost, Ballad not only matches the best individual LLM in hindsight but, in several cases, surpasses every individual model while reducing API cost by up to 65.6% relative to always using the strongest model.

articles.title: Objects as Addresses: Instance Binding in Vision Transformer Attention
articles.content: Humans naturally parse visual scenes into coherent individual objects rather than scattered features, a capability cognitive science calls object binding. While recent work shows that pretrained Vision Transformers (ViTs) intrinsically acquire this ability, how native self-attention computations mechanistically keep object instances separate remains unresolved. By studying this across eight pretrained ViTs, we found that instance separation is expressed more strongly in attention routing than in token content: selected query-key relations distinguish individual objects more reliably than value similarity or residual representations. Inside heads, patches belonging to one individual tend to read from a common image region, which we term their attention address. Visually distinct parts of one person share an address, whereas identical duplicated instances receive separate, movable addresses. These shared destinations arise in part because query interactions with the spatial structure of keys direct attention toward consistent regions for one object and elsewhere for another. In DINOv2 and most other backbones we tested, editing this query component at the selected head redirects its attention address toward another individual. Grouping patches by this query component separates same-category instances, reaching .615 FG-ARI versus .289 for the same clustering of final-layer features, which tend to merge them.

articles.title: When Both Sides Adapt: The Challenges of Evaluating Interactive LLM Systems
articles.content: In interactive systems where users engage with LLMs, users are adaptive and, after observing LLM responses, can change their prompting strategy, as well as the type and difficulty of subsequent tasks. Thus model responses can influence the set of prompts on which the model is subsequently evaluated. We study the implications of this user adaptivity and prompt endogeneity for the evaluation of LLMs. We define two classes of estimands for comparing models: the common-distribution effect, which compares model performance on the same distribution of prompts, and the induced-distribution effect, which compares each model on the prompt distribution generated through user interaction. We show that offline benchmark evaluation and live A/B testing target different quantities, with the standard difference-in-means estimators for the two methods converging to the common-distribution effect and the induced-distribution effect, respectively. This distinction can affect decision-making: the two comparisons can rank models differently and lead to discrepancies in deployment recommendations. We characterize when such ranking reversals occur and provide a sufficient condition under which the rankings are guaranteed to agree. This result provides a practical heuristic for assessing whether offline evaluation is sufficient to reproduce the decision suggested by a live experiment. Third, we show, in a stylized linear model of interactions, that user adaptivity can increase variance in estimation. Finally, we discuss implications of user adaptivity for the interpretation of experiments and show that adaptivity creates a common mechanism leading to common evaluation challenges, such as reward hacking and novelty effects. Together, this work highlights the necessity of measuring both model performance as well as changes in the user behavior that the model induces.

articles.title: HEIR: Harness Egocentric Intent for Human-Robot Interactions
articles.content: For robots to assist, serve, and collaborate with humans, they must not only interpret human requests conveyed through language and multimodal intentional cues, but also execute long-horizon tasks that interleave navigation and manipulation. In this paper, we introduce HEIR, a resource for studying how to Harness Egocentric Intent for Human-Robot Interaction. HEIR pairs human speech, measured gaze, and egocentric video with robot observations and teleoperated navigation-manipulation trajectories, while each session preserves successive episodes, with each request fulfilled through multiple execution subtasks. The captured data, together with human-authored annotations, support the study of intent grounding, execution planning, and task completion within a unified interaction setting. To demonstrate the value of HEIR, we conduct extensive offline experiments to evaluate how models benefit from additional human-centric context across these tasks, together with real-robot experiments that assess execution task completion. HEIR thus provides a valuable resource for studying user-centric robot interaction in naturalistic household environments. Our demo and dataset are available online.

articles.content: This paper presents Al Ghasali, a computational framework designed to formalize and simulate Islamic jurisprudential (Fiqh) rulings. Building upon recent set theoretic formalizations of al sabr wa al Taqsim that extract minimal operational rules as simple Horn clause logical programs, this work proves that the semantics of closed Fiqh chapters collapse completely to deterministic Finite State Automata (FSA). We establish a formal computational hierarchy, demonstrating that restricting formalization to finite propositional Horn theories guarantees decidability and constant time (O(1)) verdict extraction after offline compilation. The framework formally proves that hierarchical compositions of sub-chapter FSAs preserve this O(1) complexity, and that temporal juristic requirements, such as Tartib (order), are deterministically flattened into static ontological states, preserving the memoryless property of the automaton. To generate human-readable juristic summaries, Al Ghasali incorporates Large Language Models (LLMs) via an architecture where the deterministic FSA strictly controls the probabilistic LLM. Crucially, the paper formulates sufficient design safety conditions for this FSA LLM integration, ensuring strict adherence to the epistemological boundaries of Usul al Fiqh. To neutralize the risk of LLM hallucination, the system employs a Grammar Guided Constrained Decoding mechanism. We formally define the mapping function that dynamically constructs unambiguous right linear grammars from the FSA execution history. The paper mathematically proves that this architecture, augmented by a Bounded Neutral Lexicon and Valence Locking, guarantees the absolute absence of Decisional Hallucination, Juristic Factual Hallucination, and Semantic Inversion reducing the LLM to a pure linguistic transformer of deterministic juristic facts

articles.title: 姚期智杨植麟首次联手给 AI 出的博士级题目，Kimi 多画出了「关键一条边」
articles.content: Kimi 刷新 629 条边图论参考纪录，只多加了1条边，为什么数学界等了这么多年？    作者丨郑佳美    编辑丨岑   峰                                                                                                       给 124 个点连线，不能出现三角形，也不能出现四边形。此前的参考记录是 629 条——数学界认为这已经接近极限。而Kimi K3 构造出了 630 条边的图，并通过程序验证。多1条边，听起来不多。但在组合数学里，你每试图多塞进一条边，都需要在全图 124 个点之间重新完成一次精密的结构大重构。这1条边意味着AI第一次在“极值构造”这类研究级任务上，把人类参考纪录往前推了一步。这项成果来自图灵奖得主、中科院院士、清华大学交叉信息研究院院长姚期智与月之暗面创始人杨植麟等人的联合研究。他们真正想回答的问题是：AI到底能不能做数学研究，而不只是做数学题？01「多 1 条边」算不算真突破？姚期智，图灵奖得主、清华大学交叉信息研究院院长，是中国理论计算机科学的奠基者之一；杨植麟，月之暗面创始人，Kimi背后的推动者。两代人、两种身份：一位是理论计算机科学的泰斗，一位是大模型创业的一线操盘手，第一次联合署名。这个组合本身就说明了一件事：AI做科研，已经不是“实验室里的猜想”，而是需要理论计算机科学家和大模型团队坐在一起定义“什么叫算做出来了”。但在另一面，争议同样如影随形：多构造出一条边，到底算不算真正的科学突破？这算不算只是暴力搜索蒙对的个例？AI真懂背后的数学机理吗？这正是姚期智团队的核心初衷。如果无法区分‘运气好撞上’和‘逻辑上证明’，AI 就永远只是个黑盒计算器。于是，他们没有继续在传统基准上打转，而是联手搭了一套前所未有的评测系统——TCSExam。为回答这个问题，他们提出 TCSExam，用 100 项理论计算机科学科研任务，测试前沿 AI Agent 能否证明定理、开发 Solver、构造数学对象，甚至挑战长期未解决的猜想。论文地址：https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.07962v1实验中，GPT-6 Astra 完成了 20 项研究级定理中的 14 项，还将一个有限域矩阵猜想在特定条件下的已知证明范围从 8 维推进到了 9 维。TCSExam 的核心创新，是将 AI 科研能力转化为可以独立验证的研究成果。 它通过 Lean 4、程序检查器和 Checkpoint 机制，分别验证数学证明、算法表现及中间推导，避免把局部进展误判为完整成果。其中，Astra 的 9 维证明将复杂的矩阵问题压缩为整数约束，最终利用 143 条方程构造出可核验的矛盾证书。从任务形式化、研究证书设计到数学证明的自动检查，这套框架展示了 AI 参与真实科研的一条技术路径。02TCSExam 如何建立评测框架？一句话：把“AI 做科研”拆成四条可验证的轨道，再用三层机制防止“局部进展被误判为完整成果”。普通数学考试有标准答案，而理论计算机科学涉及的研究工作差异很大，有的需要证明新定理，有的需要开发最优算法，有的要构造满足约束的数学对象。这些成果的形式不同，评价方式也必须随之调整。研究团队因此将 100 项任务划分为四条轨道：定理证明（20 项）：覆盖 13 个理论计算机科学领域，要求模型提交 Lean 4 证明。Solver 工程（30 项）：要求开发可重复运行的算法程序，在独立测试实例和统一资源限制下评测；数学构造（20 项）：考察模型能否生成符合严格约束的图、纠错码等对象；开放猜想（30 项）：允许模型从证明成立或寻找反例两个方向展开研究。雷峰网任务划分之后，更复杂的问题出现在数学语言的转换过程中。人类研究者能够理解一段定理描述，但机器验证需要明确的定义、量词、假设和参数范围。任何一个条件发生变化，最终证明的数学含义就可能不同。例如，一个定理原本要求某种性质对任意规模的图成立，如果转写成 Lean 时额外增加了图规模限制，那么模型即使完成证明，也

articles.content: 这三个问题不解决，数据终究会成为具身最大卡点，一位前微软亚研科学家的“提前量”。    作者丨邓哲敏    编辑丨齐铖湧                                                                                                       今年初秋，Skild S1、Generalist GEN-1.5、RoboTTT 等工作密集亮相，不约而同将上下文学习（ICL）带入机器学习领域。AI科技评论（雷峰网）注意到，国内一支团队也在同一时间发布了能够实现上下文学习的世界模型，领头羊是清华大学智能产业研究院（AIR）教授曹婷。2009 年，曹婷赴澳洲读博，师从编程语言与系统领域的两位顶尖学者，研究非对称多核处理器与 Java 这类托管语言之间功耗与性能的权衡。博士期间所著论文入选 CACM 研究亮点，图灵奖得主大卫·帕特森专门撰文推荐，并收录进自己的经典教材《计算机体系结构：量化研究方法》。值得一提的是一篇发表在 ISCA 的论文：The Yin and Yang of Power and Performance for Asymmetric Hardware and Managed Software，其论证近乎诗意：虚拟机的垃圾回收、即时编译这些额外开销，恰好是可以卸到小核上去跑的差异负载，用小核的“阳”，去补虚拟机开销的“阴”；反过来，非对称硬件暴露出来的复杂性，又正好被托管语言的抽象所化解。在我们看来，这段经历埋下了影响曹婷学术生涯的东西：一个关于阴阳的直觉——约束，从不只是限制，它也可以是逼出系统生机的起点。博士毕业后，曹婷来到华为编译器与编程语言实验室，负责方舟编译器的内存管理，在有限的内存里，让程序跑得更快更省。2018 年，她加入微软亚洲研究院（MSRA）异构计算组，一待就是七年，做端侧 AI 推理，把几十亿参数的神经网络，塞进手机、PC 和 IoT 设备，让它们不靠云端，在本地的算力、功耗和存储里跑起来。低比特量化、LUT 查表推理、存算一体加速器，这些技术进入微软 Office、Windows、Bing，服务百万级用户。2025 年夏天，曹婷加入清华 AIR。这一次，横在她面前的是更凶险的约束：训练数据极度匮乏、物理环境千变万化的现实。她很快发现，机器人在固定设置下能做对动作，环境稍有变化就失败，而那些失败里藏着的宝贵信息，又被传统系统随手丢掉。具身智能已经能做 Demo，却迟迟无法真正部署。曹婷的答案，还是“阴阳”，既然约束无法穷举，那就把约束变成养分。当年 10 月，她和 MSRA 时期的老搭档、清华 AIR 副院长刘云新教授共同发起域变换（Z-Trans），押注具身自进化，并陆续发布 Z0、Zeva、Zeva Ego、Zetta、Z-infra 等工作。从让软件在异构硬件上省功耗，到让模型在边缘设备上省算力，再到让智能在物理世界里学会自进化，曹婷这十几年做的始终是同一件事：让智能在条件不充分的情况下好好工作。以下是AI科技评论与曹婷的对话，在不改变原意的基础上有所编辑。01 当机器人工厂慢慢冷下来“整体的技术范式没有收敛，而且变化特别快，基本每个月都不一样，但一个离线、一个在线这套学习范式，应该是大家统一认可的。”▎AI科技评论：今年上半年，整个行业还在疯狂建机器人数采工厂，试图用海量数据大力出奇迹。但到了下半年，陆续出现了许多具身上下文学习的工作，是前序研究证明了什么吗？曹婷：我自己的体会非常深刻。今年 5 月份之前，大家还相信“离线训一个模型，它在线就能干活”，但现在看，这些数采工厂基本都冷掉了。大家发现，离线数据采得再多，机器人在线依然干不成活，因为离线数据永远涵盖不到真实世界的全部情况。看到之前的路走不通，大家才开始思考怎样让机器人不只依赖离线训练，还能在部署后利用新的示范和反馈进行在线的上下文学习。▎AI科技评论：大家在技术上达成共识了吗？曹婷：整体上学习范式分两种：一种 offline，一种 online。在上下文中学习这个概念最早是从大语言模型（LLM
